$comment: Canonical, machine-readable definition of the Home Cage Monitoring (HCM) Minimal Metadata Form. Each field references a Common Data Element (CDE) object, not a standalone label. This file is the single source of truth consumed by App\Command\HcmMetadataFormSeedCommand to materialise CommonDataElement + CanonicalForm + CanonicalFormSection + CanonicalFormField entities. Ontology IRIs are illustrative, curated mappings; see docs/guide/metadata/hcm-minimal-metadata-form.md.

form.title: HCM Minimal Metadata Form
form.description: Minimal, FAIR-aligned metadata for Home Cage Monitoring (HCM) studies in preclinical research. Captures study, animal, cohort, housing, device, recording, behavioural-metric, and data-reuse metadata as reusable Common Data Elements grouped along the ISA Investigation/Study/Assay hierarchy.

isaMapping.comment: ISA hierarchy this form populates. Study-level sections describe the experimental subjects and conditions; Assay-level sections describe the HCM measurement and its outputs.

sections.title: Study
sections.description: Top-level study identification, objectives, design, and ethical authorisation.

fields.label: Study identifier
fields.definition: A unique identifier assigned to the HCM study.
fields.questionText: What is the unique identifier for this study?

fields.label: Experimental objective
fields.definition: The scientific objective or hypothesis the study is designed to address.
fields.questionText: What is the experimental objective of the study?

fields.label: Experimental design
fields.definition: The overall experimental design (e.g. between-subjects, within-subjects, longitudinal, crossover).

fields.label: Ethical authorization
fields.definition: Identifier or reference for the ethical/animal-welfare authorisation governing the study.
fields.questionText: What is the ethical authorisation reference for this study?

sections.title: Animals
sections.description: Biological characteristics of the experimental animals.

fields.label: Species
fields.definition: The taxonomic species of the experimental animals.

fields.label: Strain
fields.definition: The genetic strain or stock of the experimental animals.

fields.label: Genotype
fields.definition: The genotype of the experimental animals, including any genetic modifications.
fields.questionText: What is the genotype of the animals?

fields.label: Sex
fields.definition: The biological sex of the experimental animals.
fields.questionText: What is the sex of the animals?

fields.label: Age at recording
fields.definition: The age of the animals at the start of HCM recording.
fields.questionText: What was the age of the animals at recording?

fields.label: Body weight
fields.definition: The body weight of the animals at the start of HCM recording.
fields.questionText: What was the body weight of the animals?

sections.title: Cohort
sections.description: Cohort and batching structure, group assignment, and randomisation.

fields.label: Cohort ID
fields.definition: Identifier for the cohort of animals studied together.

fields.label: Batch ID
fields.definition: Identifier for the experimental batch within the cohort.

fields.label: Group assignment
fields.definition: The experimental group the animals were assigned to (e.g. control, treatment).
fields.questionText: What group were the animals assigned to?

fields.label: Randomization method
fields.definition: The method used to randomise animals to groups.
fields.questionText: How were animals randomised to groups?

sections.title: Housing
sections.description: Cage and environmental housing conditions during the study.

fields.label: Cage type
fields.definition: The type of cage used to house the animals (e.g. IVC, open-top).

fields.label: Animals per cage
fields.definition: The number of animals housed per cage.
fields.questionText: How many animals were housed per cage?

fields.label: Bedding
fields.definition: The bedding material used in the cage.

fields.label: Enrichment
fields.definition: Environmental enrichment items provided in the cage.

fields.label: Light/dark cycle
fields.definition: The light/dark cycle the animals were maintained under (e.g. 12:12 LD, lights-on time).

fields.label: Temperature
fields.definition: The ambient temperature of the housing room.

fields.label: Humidity
fields.definition: The relative humidity of the housing room.

sections.title: HCM Device
sections.description: The Home Cage Monitoring hardware and software configuration.

fields.label: Device manufacturer
fields.definition: The manufacturer of the HCM device.

fields.label: Device model
fields.definition: The model name/number of the HCM device.
fields.questionText: What is the HCM device model?

fields.label: Sensor type
fields.definition: The type of sensor(s) used by the HCM device (e.g. RFID, capacitive, PIR, load cell).
fields.questionText: What sensor type does the device use?

fields.label: Camera configuration
fields.definition: The camera configuration used for video-based monitoring (e.g. top-down RGB, IR, resolution).

fields.label: Sampling frequency
fields.definition: The data sampling frequency of the HCM device.

fields.label: Software version
fields.definition: The version of the HCM acquisition/analysis software.

sections.title: Recording Protocol
sections.description: Habituation, recording window, interventions, and disturbance events.

fields.label: Habituation duration
fields.definition: The duration animals were habituated to the HCM cage before recording.
fields.questionText: How long were animals habituated before recording?

fields.label: Recording start/end
fields.definition: The start and end timestamps of the HCM recording window.
fields.questionText: When did recording start and end?

fields.label: Intervention timing
fields.definition: The timing of any interventions (e.g. treatment, surgery) relative to recording.
fields.questionText: When did interventions occur relative to recording?

fields.label: Cleaning/disturbance events
fields.definition: Recorded cage cleaning or disturbance events during the recording window.
fields.questionText: What cleaning or disturbance events occurred?

sections.title: Behavioral Metrics
sections.description: Definitions of the behavioural metrics derived from HCM data.

fields.label: Activity metric definition
fields.definition: Definition and method for the locomotor activity metric.
fields.questionText: How is the activity metric defined?

fields.label: Sleep/rest definition
fields.definition: Definition and method for the sleep/rest metric (e.g. immobility threshold).

fields.label: Feeding metric definition
fields.definition: Definition and method for the feeding/food-intake metric.
fields.questionText: How is the feeding metric defined?

fields.label: Social proximity definition
fields.definition: Definition and method for the social proximity / interaction metric.

fields.label: Circadian aggregation method
fields.definition: Method used to aggregate metrics over the circadian cycle (e.g. cosinor, hourly binning).
fields.questionText: How are metrics aggregated over the circadian cycle?

sections.title: Data Reuse
sections.description: Availability, licensing, and export format of study data for FAIR reuse.

fields.label: Raw data available?
fields.definition: Whether raw HCM data is available for reuse.

fields.label: Processed data available?
fields.definition: Whether processed/derived HCM data is available for reuse.

fields.label: Code available?
fields.definition: Whether analysis code is available for reuse.

fields.label: DOI
fields.definition: The Digital Object Identifier of the dataset.

fields.label: License
fields.definition: The license under which the dataset is released.
fields.questionText: What license applies to the dataset?

fields.label: Export format
fields.definition: The export/encoding format of the released dataset.
